question:
Sunlight is scattered by very small particles in the atmosphere (single Rayleigh scattering). An observer looks at different points in the sky such that the angle between the line of sight and the line joining the observer to the Sun is $\phi$ (the scattering angle).

(i) State the expected state of polarisation of the scattered light for $\phi=90^\circ$ and briefly justify.

(ii) State the expected state of polarisation of the scattered light for $\phi=0^\circ$ (looking toward the Sun) and for $\phi=180^\circ$ (looking directly away from the Sun), and justify your answer using the symmetry of scattering.

(iii) Based on (i) and (ii), identify at which of the given angles the degree of polarisation is maximum.
